strategies.name: Triple EMA Ribbon Fan-Out (5/8/13 EMA)
strategies.entry: ema(close, 5) > ema(close, 8) > ema(close, 13) and rising(ema(close, 5) - ema(close, 13), 3)
assumptions: 'expanding over 3 bars' = the EMA5-EMA13 spread rose on each of the last 3 bars

strategies.name: Impulse MACD Surge
strategies.entry: macd(close) > macd_signal(close) and macd(close) > sma(macd(close), 20) + $k * stdev(macd(close), 20)
assumptions: Upper_StdDev_Band(MACD, 20) = SMA(MACD,20) + k x StdDev(MACD,20); k not given, default 2
